description: Test suite for account-related functionalities in ERPNext, including account creation, merging, renaming, and synchronization, with dependencies on frappe framework and ERPNext modules.

classes.name: TestAccount
classes.description: Unit tests for account operations such as renaming, merging, syncing, and validation within ERPNext.

methods.name: test_rename_account
methods.description: Tests renaming an account and verifying the update in the database.

methods.name: test_merge_account
methods.description: Tests merging two accounts and validation of parent-child relationships and error conditions.

methods.name: test_account_sync
methods.description: Tests synchronization of account names across different companies.

methods.name: test_add_account_to_a_group
methods.description: Tests validation when adding an account to a group account.

methods.name: test_account_rename_sync
methods.description: Tests renaming an account and ensuring updates propagate to related accounts.

methods.name: test_child_company_account_rename_sync
methods.description: Tests renaming of child company accounts with validation for company-specific constraints.

methods.name: _make_test_records
methods.description: Creates test account records for unit testing.

methods.name: get_inventory_account
methods.description: Retrieves inventory account for a company, optionally for a specific warehouse.

methods.name: create_account
methods.description: Creates a new account record if it does not already exist.
